threadDescriptions.harbour-portfolio: Prepare the portfolio for the Harbour design scholarship
threadDescriptions.harbour-interview: Prepare for and attend the Harbour scholarship interview
threadDescriptions.bursary-income: Provide household-income evidence for the college access bursary
threadDescriptions.dog-sitting: Arrange care for Pip while I am away
threadDescriptions.print-reimbursement: Recover the agreed portfolio printing expense from college

items.text: Harbour portfolio shortlist: bus-stop redesign, folding stool, tactile map. Each spread needs the problem, two process images and the final result.
items.rationale: Selects and structures the design-award portfolio.

items.text: Access bursary office needs last quarter's household income statement. The uploaded page only shows one month; request the full period from payroll.
items.rationale: Financial-evidence requirement for a distinct college bursary.

items.text: Pip's sitter can do both nights. Write feeding amounts on the tub and show her where the spare lead hangs.
items.rationale: Arranges pet care.

items.text: Harbour panel invite says a five-minute portfolio walkthrough, followed by questions. Practise explaining one design decision without reading the slide.
items.rationale: Interview format and preparation.

items.text: Portfolio print quote: 46 for two stitched copies. College tutor approved reimbursement up to 50; keep the itemised invoice and approval message.
items.rationale: Records agreed expense recovery and its evidence.

items.text: Tactile map spread is crowded. Remove the decorative mockup and enlarge the prototype photo so the raised route is visible.
items.rationale: Edits an identifiable project spread in the portfolio.

items.text: Access bursary statement now covers all three months. Redact the unrelated bank-account digits before sending it through the college portal.
items.rationale: Prepares the requested financial evidence for submission.

items.text: Interview timing correction from Harbour: eight minutes for the walkthrough, not five. Add the stool testing example but keep a short version in case they interrupt.
items.rationale: Explicit revision of the previously stated presentation duration.

items.text: Is the second copy the clean one?
items.rationale: No named document or purpose identifies the intended copy.

items.text: Harbour rehearsal exposed a gap: the portfolio shows the final stool but not the load test. Add one test photograph to that spread, and use it in the interview to explain why the first hinge failed.
items.rationale: Directs both portfolio revision and a specific interview explanation.

items.text: Pip trial evening with the sitter: settles better if the blanket stays by the sofa. Leave the usual bowl rather than buying a travel one.
items.rationale: Practical pet-care handoff.

items.text: College reimbursement form wants proof of payment, not just the portfolio printer's quote. Attach the paid invoice for 46 and the tutor's approval.
items.rationale: Completes an expense claim's evidence.

items.text: Rename my 'Harbour talk' notes to 'Harbour interview'. Keep the panel questions and rehearsal timings in the same place.
items.rationale: Explicit rename of the interview-preparation collection.

items.text: Portfolio final export: 12 spreads, embedded fonts, no crop marks in the digital copy. Printed copies look sharp enough around the tactile-map texture.
items.rationale: Final quality check of the application work product.

items.text: Access bursary staff accepted the quarterly statement. They need a brief explanation of the one-off overtime payment before completing the income assessment.
items.rationale: Responds to a financial-assessment follow-up.

items.text: Harbour mock panel: I answered 'who benefits?' too generally. Use the bus stop wheelchair turning-space example and state what changed after testing.
items.rationale: Refines interview answers using portfolio evidence.

items.text: Expense claim returned because the tutor approval was sideways. Rotate that page and resubmit the portfolio printing reimbursement.
items.rationale: Repairs a rejected expense attachment.

items.text: Sitter has Pip's food tub, key and emergency contact card. Pickup agreed for Sunday after lunch.
items.rationale: Completes the pet-care arrangement.

items.text: Harbour interview done. Panel spent most of the time on prototype changes; send the requested stool-test image through the applicant portal.
items.rationale: Interview outcome and panel-requested follow-up.

items.text: Explained that the overtime was a single holiday-cover payment. College access bursary evidence is now marked complete.
items.rationale: Resolves the income-documentation question.

undo.reason: Hypothetical correction: this source assembles payment evidence for reimbursement, not the portfolio itself.
